### What does this PR do?

Follow up [#8308](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pull/8308) by explicitly selecting the vLLM Triton Linear and MoE backends in the L20 FP8 MoE end-to-end test. #8308 made DeepGEMM the default for low-precision rollouts when no engine backend is configured, but L20 is SM89 and does not support that DeepGEMM path. The existing dense L20 smoke test already carries the same override; this change applies it to the Qwen3-30B-A3B MoE workflow as well.

This is not a duplicate: searches for [L20 Triton FP8 MoE](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+L20+Triton+FP8+MoE) and [the affected workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+e2e_ppo_trainer_megatron_vllm_2) found no open PR addressing this test.

AI assistance was used to inspect backend-selection behavior, update the workflow, run checks, and prepare this PR description. The human submitter reviewed the change and is responsible for it.

### Checklist Before Starting

- [x] Search for similar PRs: [L20 Triton FP8 MoE](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+L20+Triton+FP8+MoE) and [affected workflow](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Aopen+e2e_ppo_trainer_megatron_vllm_2).
- [x] Format the PR title as `[{modules}] {type}: {description}`.

### Test

```bash
uv run python -c 'import pathlib, yaml; yaml.safe_load(pathlib.Path(".github/workflows/e2e_ppo_trainer_megatron_vllm_2.yml").read_text())'
# passed

uv run --frozen --extra test pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always
# all hooks passed

git diff --check
# passed
```

The GPU end-to-end job itself was not run locally; this PR updates that CI job to exercise the fix.

### API and Usage Example

No public API changes. The CI invocation now supplies:

```yaml
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.linear_backend=triton
+actor_rollout_ref.rollout.engine_kwargs.vllm.moe_backend=triton
```

### Design & Code Changes

- Preserve the `FP8_BLOCK` rollout configuration.
- Explicitly select Triton for both dense Linear and routed MoE kernels on the L20 runner.
- Keep the override scoped to this hardware-specific CI invocation.

### Checklist Before Submitting

- [x] Read the [Contribute Guide](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [x] Apply [pre-commit checks](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#code-linting-and-formatting): `uv run --frozen --extra test pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure --color=always`.
- [ ] Add / Update [the documentation](https://github.com/verl-project/verl/tree/main/docs). Not applicable: this only corrects a hardware-specific CI invocation.
- [x] Add unit or end-to-end test coverage. The affected L20 vLLM FP8 MoE workflow is the test being corrected.
- [ ] Once the PR is ready for CI, send a message in the [`ci-request` channel](https://verl-project.slack.com/archives/C091TCESWB1).

This PR is not related to the `recipe` submodule.
